description: These three Radiant Earth datasets give ground reference crop type labels for fields in East Africa, first published on Radiant MLHub for machine learning: the CV4A Competition Kenya crop type dataset (collected 2019), the PlantVillage Kenya ground reference crop type dataset (2019) and the Great African Food Company Tanzania ground reference crop type dataset (2018). The DataCite records and the Source Cooperative page read say the Kenya competition set now sits on Source Cooperative with documentation and a field ID table, created there on 5 July 2023 and last updated on 21 August 2025, public to download. Licences differ: CC BY-SA 4.0 for the two Kenya sets and CC BY 4.0 for the Tanzania set, all free. Coverage is parts of Kenya and Tanzania. Caveats: the number of fields, the paired satellite imagery and the crop classes are described in the documentation, not on the pages read, and the areas are small. For simulation they train crop type maps for smallholder regions where official maps are missing, which then set agricultural exposure to drought and floods. Related catalogue records include the GhanaMining-Sat benchmark, the WRI TRAZO field boundaries and the CAWa crop type polygons for Central Asia.
